hero.headline: Perched above Broadway.
hero.subtitle: Newmarket's rooftop restaurant and cocktail bar. Wood-fired pizza, fresh pasta and long afternoons in the sun.

intro.body1: An open kitchen, a garden courtyard and a terrace with views down Broadway to the sea. Brunch till 3pm every day, dinner under the lights, and a cocktail list that takes its job seriously.
intro.body2: Bring the crew, bring the kids, bring the office. We keep the good times fed.
intro.headline: One level above the rush.

booking.headline: Pull up a chair.
booking.finePrint: Groups of 8 or more, call 09 218 5085 and we'll sort you out.

items.name: Irene Lizardo
items.quote: Celebrated my son's 29th birthday at the rooftop. Very happy with our order and their service. Social platter was massive, and the mocktails did not disappoint. 5 star rating overall for food, service and experience.

items.name: Yebin Lee
items.quote: Visited on busy Friday night, yet the service was epic. Zero confusion, no rushing, everyone nice and kind. Perfect suggestions on food and very attentive. Nice and cozy atmosphere, nice bar.

items.name: Jonivie
items.quote: Thank you so much for accommodating our last minute booking for 16 people on a Sunday lunch. Service was topnotch and food was incredibly delicious. Highly recommended and will definitely be coming back.

items.note: Buy any drink, we sling you a pasta.
$10 tap beers, house wines, mimosas and prosecco.

rituals.extrasNote: Plus brunch every day till 3pm, kids under 12 eat free on Sundays, and a free dessert for the birthday star.

functions.intro: Birthdays, hens dos, baby showers, engagements, Christmas parties and corporate offsites. Pick a space, pick a menu, and we handle the rest.

spaces.name: Restaurant & Lounge
spaces.blurb: The open kitchen at work, comfortable booths and room to move. Cosy get-togethers to full-scale celebrations.

spaces.name: Rooftop Terrace
spaces.blurb: Views down Broadway to the sea. Drinks, canapés and sunsets. The one everyone asks for.

spaces.name: Courtyard
spaces.blurb: A green pocket filled with plants. Relaxed, family-friendly, made for slow afternoons.

spaces.name: Front Outside Courtyard
spaces.blurb: A lively, inviting corner at the front of the venue. Trendy without trying too hard.

spaces.name: Beside the Play Area
spaces.blurb: Right next to the rooftop playground. Parents relax, kids run wild, everyone wins.

spaces.name: The Full Venue
spaces.blurb: All of it. Restaurant, courtyards and terrace, exclusively yours for the big one.

functions.headline: No hire fee. No fuss. Just the party.
functions.enquiryNote: Set menus with mains, desserts and pizzas, or canapés and platters for a looser vibe. Ask us for the full packages and pricing.

manifesto.body: Birthdays. Long lunches. Wednesday for no reason. Whatever you're up to, the kitchen and the bar have your back.
